preserved_phase2a3b1_decision: NO-GO pending failed Phase 2A.3b-1 morphology-signal gate

controlled_campaign.alpha_zero_reuse_rule: Alpha zero is identical for both edge policies, so one paired trajectory per seed is reused as the common control.

proposed_physical_closure_not_implemente.statement: Define facet or interface-patch volume flux as dV_k/dt proportional to A_k times kappa(n_k), normalize the integrated fluxes to the externally supplied salt-volume budget, and use voxel insertion only as a conservative geometric realization step.
proposed_physical_closure_not_implemente.reason: Candidate-site counts and digital staircasing are numerical properties; they must not define physical facet-normal velocity.
proposed_physical_closure_not_implemente.edge_requirement: Edges and corners require an explicit interface partition or flux-sharing rule before implementation; assigning unit site weight is not a physical closure.

locked_protocol: The 15-case single-orientation campaign, three paired seeds, five cumulative depths, metrics, original 1.25 signal threshold, and two-thirds sign-consistency rule were frozen after the one-case feasibility gate and before controlled outcomes. Phase 2A.3b-1 remains failed regardless of this result.
